# Code of conduct

OpenPixo is made for people who make games, and everyone who takes part,
in issues, pull requests, discussions or anywhere else the project is
represented, should feel welcome doing it.

## What we expect

- Be kind and assume good intent. Disagree about ideas, not people.
- Give feedback that helps: specific, actionable and about the work.
- Welcome newcomers and people with less experience; everyone started somewhere.
- Respect people's time, privacy and boundaries.
- Own your mistakes and help fix them.

## What is not acceptable

- Harassment, insults, threats or personal attacks.
- Discriminatory jokes or language, or sexualised content and attention.
- Publishing someone's private information without their permission.
- Trolling, deliberately derailing a conversation, or sustained disruption.
- Anything else a reasonable person would consider inappropriate in a
  professional setting.

## Enforcement

Report a problem to **support@openpixo.com**. Reports are read by the
maintainers and handled in confidence. Depending on what happened, we may ask
someone to change their behaviour, remove their contributions, or ban them
from the project, temporarily or for good.

This code of conduct is inspired by the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/).
